scope: D2 selected-source V2 producer, shared types and identity factory

verification.authority: Focused loader tests mock canonical actor and program services; they establish producer orchestration and refusal, not genuine database authorization or locking.
verification.limits: Loader-return source checks establish a point-in-time checkpoint. They do not prove provider dispatch/delivery, comprehension, scientific qualification or agency acceptance.

behavior: V2 hashes bind complete well-formed extracted text and exact original UTF-16 slice.
Selected IDs and serving-context identity/project/executor are copied before asynchronous imports or reads.
Canonical actor metadata identity must match text identity; all sources are privately reloaded and validated after assembly.
Original-file availability, disposition, extraction metadata and source eligibility changes refuse the entire context.
One-unit inward boundary adjustment prevents splitting a valid surrogate pair without normalizing text.
Audit metadata retains version and hashes with copied spans and no raw evidence text.
Existing 12,000-unit per-source and 48,000-unit aggregate budgets remain in effect.
